sharedRules.name: Armoured Reserve
sharedRules.description:
In missions with Deep Reserves, you may only field one Armoured Reserves Tank Unit, one Tank Unit with Front Armour of 4 or more, or one Aircraft Unit on the table at the start of the game.
Tanks with Armoured Reserve are BattleTanks for the purpose of the Deep Reservesand similar rules. (LFTF)

sharedRules.name: Hunters
sharedRules.description: Infantry Teams treat Snow, Woods, or Forests as Cross-country Dash instead of Terrain Dash.

sharedRules.name: Panzerfaust - Limited 1
sharedRules.description:
Each time this Unit shoots, one of its Teams may shoot as a Panzerfaust rather than its usual weapons.
Each time this Unit rolls To Hit in an assault, one of its Teams may attack with a Panzerfaust rather than its usual weapons.

sharedRules.name: Bazooka Skirts
sharedRules.description: A Tank Team with Bazooka Skirts increases its Side armour to 5 against weapons with Firepower 5+ or 6.
